# Thunderbird Mail Interface Description

## System and Window Header

- **Top Bar**: A system-level header bar is visible at the very top of the screen.
  - Left side: "Activities" label.
  - Center: "Thunderbird Mail" application title.
  - Right side: System indicators including date and time ("Oct 23 00:04"), a notification bell icon, and system controls (minimize, maximize, close buttons).

## Notification Banner

- **Floating Notification**: Positioned in the upper center of the window, below the system header.
  - **Content**: "mathias.gadenzi@gmail.com received 1 new message" on the first line, and "Critical security alert from Google" on the second line.
  - **Icon**: A blue Thunderbird logo icon is on the left side of the notification.
  - **Appearance**: A white rectangular banner with rounded corners.

## Main Application Window

### Left Sidebar (Navigation Panel)

- **Application Icon**: A blue envelope icon at the top of the sidebar.
- **Navigation Icons (Vertical Stack)**:
  - **Mail Icon**: Envelope icon.
  - **Calendar Icon**: Calendar icon.
  - **Tasks Icon**: Checkmark icon.
  - **Chat Icon**: Speech bubble icon.
- **Account Section**:
  - **Account Name**: "mathias.gadenzi@gmail..." with a blue notification badge showing "1" (indicating one unread message).
  - **Folder Structure**:
    - **Local Folders**: A folder icon with a downward arrow indicating it is expanded.
      - **Trash**: A trash can icon.
      - **Outbox**: An envelope with a plus sign icon.
      - **Important**: A folder icon with a yellow star or important marker.
- **Action Button**:
  - **New Message Button**: A blue rectangular button with white text "+ New Message" and a small ellipsis icon ("...") to its right.

### Center Panel (Message List)

- **Folder Header**:
  - **Folder Name**: "Important" in bold.
  - **Message Count**: "0 Messages" next to the folder name.
- **Quick Filter**:
  - **Filter Button**: A "Quick Filter" button with a funnel icon and a small downward arrow.
- **Message List Area**:
  - **Content**: The area is empty, indicating no messages are present in the "Important" folder.
  - **Appearance**: White background with no visible messages or message headers.

### Right Panel (Welcome Screen)

- **Header**:
  - **Title**: "Welcome to FREEDOM" in large, bold text.
  - **Subtitle**: "Thunderbird is a gift from thousands of people like you. We hope you'll enjoy the productivity, privacy, and freedom they make possible and we invite you to become part of that gift to others."
- **Donate Button**:
  - **Button**: A blue oval button with a pink heart icon and the text "Donate".
  - **Text Below**: "Help keep Thunderbird alive!" in smaller text.
- **Feature Boxes**:
  - **Left Box: "Free and Open Source"**:
    - **Subtitle**: "Thunderbird is now yours forever."
    - **Description**: "Thunderbird is developed openly and distributed freely. Our software license protects your right to use, modify, and share Thunderbird. Our mission is to protect your privacy and freedom."
    - **Button**: "Get Help" button with a heart icon.
  - **Right Box: "Powered by Community"**:
    - **Subtitle**: "You can become part of our story."
    - **Description**: "Anyone can contribute to Thunderbird. By donating, translating, answering questions, suggesting features, reporting bugs, and more, you make Thunderbird better for yourself and the world."
    - **Button**: "Participate" button with a pencil icon.
- **Footer Message**:
  - **Text**: "Want new features sooner? Learn about Thunderbird Release."
  - **Appearance**: A white rounded rectangular banner with a blue hyperlink for "Thunderbird Release".

## System Tray and Desktop Environment

- **Left Dock (Desktop Environment)**:
  - **Application Icons**: A vertical stack of application icons including Chrome, Firefox, Visual Studio Code, VLC, LibreOffice Writer, LibreOffice Calc, LibreOffice Impress, GIMP, Files, App Store, Help, and Trash.
  - **Settings Icon**: A gear icon at the bottom of the dock.
  - **Application Grid Icon**: A 3x3 grid icon at the very bottom for accessing all applications.
- **Bottom Left Corner**:
  - **System Indicator**: A small "(co)" text, likely indicating a system status or connection indicator.

## Search Bar

- **Location**: Centered at the top of the main window, below the notification banner.
- **Content**: A search bar with placeholder text "Search..." and a keyboard shortcut hint
